learning_outcomes.text: Students will gain a system of knowledge about assessment methods through calculations of the advisability, reliability, and effectiveness of the shapes and dimensions of structural elements.

syllabus_topics: Introduction. Basic terms and principles, stress, deflections, strain
Testing of materials, basic mechanical properties
Torsion of circular and noncircular bars
Moments of area of cross sections
Plane bending and 3D bending, deflections in bending, deflected axis of a beam

assessment_methods.method: Individually assigned complex course task presentation

assessment_rules: The final grade is accumulated from the grades of the three tests and from the grade of the course task presentation. Regular attendance of classes and course paper submission are requirements for semester validation. Assessment is continuous.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
